design_notes: Authoritative reader streams in batches of 100 and retains one latest event per document; single-document reads stop on the first exact match.
Exact decoded scope comparison preserves profile/application isolation across SQLite and PostgreSQL SQL dialects without adding JSON casts.
Exact deterministic operation lookup validates complete immutable payload and entity scope, including no-op requests.
Before/after current-state comparison remains inside existing ownership locks and transaction.
limits: A full history scan and database sorting can still be required; result memory is bounded by distinct documents plus a fetch batch.
Preexisting profile-wide API idempotency-preflight concurrency across distinct actions/applications is not repaired or certified here.
